I see the alignment handling. For R9, left-aligned (`<`) and center-aligned (`^`) search operations must consume input up to the next space character. Currently:
- `<` uses `s = '%s%s*' % (s, fill)` - which means it matches the content followed by any number of fill characters
- `>` uses `s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)` - right aligned with fill padding before
- `^` uses `s = '%s*%s%s*' % (fill, s, fill)` - center aligned with fill on both sides

For R9, the requirement is that left- and center-aligned search operations must consume input up to the next space character. This means the regex should match until a space (or non-fill character) is encountered.
